sources.snippet: This repository contains the MiniCPM-o 2.6 model weights in GGUF format, used for llama.cpp. Currently, this readme only supports minicpm-omni's vision capabilities, and we will update the full-mode support as soon as possible.

sources.title: MiniCPM-o-2_6-gguf: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview MiniCPM-o-2_6-gguf is a GGUF-quantized version of the MiniCPM-o 2.6 multimodal large language model designed for vision, speech, and multimodal processing on resource-constrained devices. Built and maintained by openbmb, this model replicates GPT-4o-level capabilities while remaining deployable on mobile phones. sources.snippet: MiniCPM-o-2_6-gguf huggingface.co is an AI model on huggingface.co that provides MiniCPM-o-2_6-gguf's model effect (), which can be used instantly with this openbmb MiniCPM-o-2_6-gguf model. huggingface.co supports a free trial of the MiniCPM-o-2_6-gguf model, and also provides paid use of the MiniCPM-o-2_6-gguf.
